summary: Very strong T2 module: unauth /_cat/indices with doc counts, /_nodes/_local OS+JVM fingerprint, /_snapshot/_all with per-repo settings extraction (bucket/endpoint/region/base_path/location) for cloud-storage pivot, plus a specific anonymous-role discriminator via /_security/_authenticate. Auth-header support (Basic, Bearer, ApiKey). Gaps: no CVE-2015-1427 Groovy-sandbox probe, no scripting-enabled check, no _search document sampling in the probe (only counts), no snapshot-restore-arbitrary-read PoC.

findings.tier_evidence: /_cat/indices returns 200 with the real index array and doc counts; deep enum captures node OS/JVM and snapshot repo settings inline.
findings.promotion_notes: Add /_search?size=10&pretty per user-index to sample real documents (T3 evidence); dump snapshot metadata (snapshots per repo) to prove restore-tampering surface. Feed snapshot repo credentials (client name) into a cloud-cred pool.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -s 'http://<ip>:<port>/*/_search?size=20&pretty' > loot/es.json ; elasticdump --input=http://<ip>:<port>/<index> --output=loot/<index>.json ; then map snapshot bucket to aws s3 ls s3://<bucket>/<base_path>.

findings.title_pattern: Elasticsearch anonymous role grants unauthenticated access
findings.tier_evidence: /_security/_authenticate returns 200 with username _anonymous / authentication_type anonymous - deterministic verify that fires only when the misconfig is present.
findings.promotion_notes: Immediately follow with /_cat/indices (or a Doc _search) as _anonymous to prove the granted role actually reads data - T2 = document/list read under anon.

findings.tier_evidence: Version major<7 fingerprint; no scripting-sandbox CVE probe (CVE-2015-1427, CVE-2014-3120).
findings.promotion_notes: On <=1.4.2 send the CVE-2014-3120 groovy source in a MVEL script _search and check for a benign echo. On <=1.4.4 test CVE-2015-1427 with the sandbox-escape payload against a canary. Destructive-risk medium (executes JVM code).
findings.tester_next_step: curl -s -XPOST 'http://<ip>:<port>/_search?pretty' -d '{"script_fields":{"a":{"script":"1+1"}}}' - a returned 2 confirms scripting enabled; then swap in the CVE-2015-1427 sandbox escape (in-scope only).

proposed_shared_surface_consumers: credentials.apikey (echo any Bearer/ApiKey creds validated across cluster)
